reason: Composes one shared-targeting dialog, its current-read gate, the controlled form and an explicit read-only discard/reload confirmation. The personal entry only receives the configured backend and current-source disable state. Native transport, receipt projection, actor/client proof and the active request lifetime remain in separate owners; no service mutation or authentication policy is implemented in this container.

Presents the existing Issue areas, Intel State coverage, optional profile suggestions and WatchlistTopics fields as one controlled targeting draft. It preserves the partial-rejection explanation and local correction flow, then composes explicit save/reload or unknown-result actions. Topic-specific field operations remain in WatchlistTopics; transport, current authority, cache effects and unknown fencing are excluded from this presentation owner.

Combines the exact current client and owner-specific targeting, taxonomy and jurisdiction reads for one Configure source boundary. Reader-key derivation and source validation are in watchlist-source, while canonical Profile actor/client primitives are reused through the narrow public facade and native targeting IO stays in watchlist-writer. The subscriptions and three query lifecycles must share this captured reader so a successful sibling feed cannot accidentally authorize stale targeting.

Owns one retained targeting draft and its explicit save/reload transaction. Native request projection and receipt parsing, current actor/client/source assertions, and synchronous interruption/uncertainty tracking have separate module owners. The remaining state and cache/UI effect sequence is one coupled editor lifetime: publishing a receipt, advancing the base version and retaining rejected edits must agree before closing this exact view.

Runs one selected save or read-only reload from a captured reviewed source through the same interruption latch, then checks the exact replacement source revision before each cache or UI effect. The two branches deliberately share lifetime and failure handling; native Core/Intel dispatch and receipt semantics are delegated to watchlist-writer. No unrelated service, global authorization owner or automatic retry flow is mixed into this transaction.
